storyCards.headline: Livin' On A Prayer: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Bon Jovi's "Livin' On A Prayer" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 22 weeks on the chart.

Livin' On A Prayer was released in 2001.

Album: One Wild Night: Live 1985--2001 (2001).

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
